Priya Kumar: Quick ask — can someone run an initial dev/staging bring-up for gulliver-4b (fp16 then int8) and paste quick sanity checks here? Focus: basic correctness on commonsense QA, code completions, token counts, and any quant artifacts. I pushed model v0.1-alpha to s3://redwood-models/gulliver-4b/v0.1-alpha.

Alex Moran: On it. I'll run a default inference pass with batch=1, max_new_tokens=128. ETA 10m. @Jin Park want me to try `--q8_0` or `--q4_0` first?

Jin Park: Try q8 first, then q4 if q8 looks good. q4 may increase latency jitter. Also run a tiny deterministic eval set:
```
PROMPTS = [
  "Q: What is the capital of France? A:",
  "Q: Write a python function to reverse a list. A:",
  "Q: Explain in one sentence why batteries degrade. A:"
]
```

Alex Moran: Results (fp16):
```
Prompt1 -> "Paris"
Prompt2 -> "def reverse_list(lst):\n    return lst[::-1]"
Prompt3 -> "Batteries degrade due to chemical side reactions and loss of active material."
```
No obvious hallucinations on these.

Alex Moran: Results (q8_0): same answers, minor tokenization spacing on code (extra space before colon). Latency: fp16 median=45ms, q8 median=30ms, p95 fp16=110ms, p95 q8=95ms. Token throughput roughly 180 tok/s on this VM.

Marco Silva: Noted. Can you dump logits/top-k for the second prompt to check if code tokenization got shifted? small snippet ok.

Alex Moran: Pasted top tokens for prompt2: `['def', ' ', 'reverse_list', '(', 'lst', ')', ':', '\n', '    ', 'return', ...]` — colon token aligned but there's an extra space token before colon in q8 run. Looks like token merge issue.

QA-Bot: Automated sanity suite finished (50 prompts): 48 passed, 2 flagged (formatting; one code whitespace, one missing trailing period). Regression score: +0.9% formatting error vs baseline. Logs: https://internal-ci/reports/gulliver-v0.1-alpha/1794001234

Priya Kumar: Thanks. For onboarding checklist: capture model card, quant config (`q8_0` params used), perf table, and a short note on the whitespace artifact. @Alex Moran can you add a minimal repro snippet and upload to the model intake ticket?

Alex Moran: Yep will add repro and a tiny script to reproduce tokenization spacing. Uploading now.

deploy-bot: Deployment to dev-staging completed: model=gulliver-4b v0.1-alpha, runtime=triton-2.4.2, node=dev-inf-07

Priya Kumar: Great. Plan: leave q8 as default for dev, schedule a deeper eval (1000 prompts + codebench) next week, and decide q4 after we measure jitter and quality delta. Filing follow-up ticket: ML-8472. Closing this thread for now — thanks all :v:
